results.name: ctl_prove_n16_nb2
results.claim: the slave-side control at N = 16, NB = 2 keeps the gap rule (0 idle clocks or at least N/8, never in between), the frame credit (never more than NB frames in the block, counter equal to the shadow count, a start refused while NB are in), tready high inside a frame, the window after a tlast beat open when there is room, for every source and sink that obey the AXI4-Stream rules; proved for all time by k-induction (depth 14) from helper invariants on the window flag and the gap counter
